10.2.71 BswMPduRouterControl
SWS Item
[ECUC_BswM_00853]
Container Name
BswMPduRouterControl
Parent Container
BswMAvailableActions
▽
△
Description
This container includes all parameters related to enabling and disabling of routing of
Routing Path Groups in the PDU Router. PduR_EnableRouting or PduR_Disable
Routing is called when this action is configured.
Configuration Parameters
SWS Item
[ECUC_BswM_00854]
Parameter Name
BswMPduRouterAction
Parent Container
BswMPduRouterControl
Description
This parameter specifies if the routing of the corresponding PDU should be enabled or
disabled.
Multiplicity
caption: 10.2.71 BswMPduRouterControl

targets.why: The passage specifies that PduR_EnableRouting is called when the BswMPduRouterControl action is configured.
